about: Tender/funding notices that a newer notice has replaced (same procedure, e.g. a moved deadline). The map gate (.github/scripts/check_map_issue.py) fails while map/data.js still shows an 'old' ID. Maintained by the Kartograf: add a pair whenever a map update replaces a notice. Keep entries; never delete them.

superseded.what: Kutno GT-1/GT-2 geothermal wells (ECO Kutno, PL): new notice in the same TED procedure moved the deadline from 24 Nov to 8 Dec 2026, 10:00 CET
